parameters.label: Primitive  Type
parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select from the following types. For information on the different types, see the  Geometry  category articles.

parameters.label: Connectivity
parameters.name: surftype
parameters.description: ⊞  - This option is used to select the type of surface, when using a  Mesh  primitive type.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Creates horizontal lines.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: Creates vertical lines.

parameters.label: Rows and Columns
parameters.name: rowcol
parameters.description: Both Rows and Columns. Looks like Quads in wire frame display, but all polygons are open (if the primitive type is polygon).

parameters.label: Triangles
parameters.name: triangles
parameters.description: Build the grid with Triangles.

parameters.label: Quadrilaterals
parameters.name: quads
parameters.description: Generates sides composed of quadrilaterals (default).

parameters.label: Alternating Triangles
parameters.name: alttriangles
parameters.description: Generates triangles that are opposed; similar to the  Triangles  option.

parameters.label: Orientation
parameters.name: orient
parameters.description: ⊞  - The axis along which the torus is constructed.

parameters.label: Modify Bounds
parameters.name: modifybounds
parameters.description: Enabled only when an input is connected to the Torus  SOP  to set bounds for the torus. Turn Modify Bounds = On to enable the transform parameters below to further modify the position and radius of the bounds.

parameters.label: Radius
parameters.name: rad
parameters.description: ⊞  - The first value (radx) defines the radius of the torus, the second value (rady) determines the radius of the inner ring.

parameters.label: Center
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - Offset of torus center from object origin.

parameters.label: Reverse Anchors
parameters.name: reverseanchors
parameters.description: Invert the direction of anchors.

parameters.label: Anchor U
parameters.name: anchoru
parameters.description: Set the point in X about which the geometry is positioned, scaled and rotated.

parameters.label: Anchor V
parameters.name: anchorv
parameters.description: Set the point in Y about which the geometry is positioned, scaled and rotated.

parameters.label: Anchor W
parameters.name: anchorw
parameters.description: Set the point in Z about which the geometry is positioned, scaled and rotated.

parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: The rows define the number of divisions along the torus.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: The columns determine the number of divisions along the torus' cross-section.

parameters.label: Angle Offset
parameters.name: angleoffset
parameters.description: Rotates the torus along the minor radius.  For example, if using 4 rows set this value to 45 to create flat top + bottom surfaces.

parameters.label: Imperfect
parameters.name: imperfect
parameters.description: This option applies only to Bezier and NURBS types. If selected, the tube is an approximated nonrational curve, otherwise it is a perfect rational curve.

parameters.label: U Order
parameters.name: orderu
parameters.description: If a spline curve is selected, it is built at this order for U and V.

parameters.label: V Order
parameters.name: orderv
parameters.description: If a spline curve is selected, it is built at this order for U and V.

parameters.label: U Angle
parameters.name: angleu
parameters.description: ⊞  - The start and end sweep angles of the torus, if  U Wrap  is not enabled.

parameters.label: V Angle
parameters.name: anglev
parameters.description: ⊞  - These are the start and end angles of the cross-section circle that is swept to make the torus, if  V Wrap  is not enabled.

parameters.label: U Wrap
parameters.name: closeu
parameters.description: If  U Wrap  is checked, it creates a 360 cross-section.

parameters.label: V Wrap
parameters.name: closev
parameters.description: Checking  V Wrap  creates a torus along V by closing the primitive.

parameters.label: U End Caps
parameters.name: capu
parameters.description: If  U End Caps  is checked, it puts faceted end-caps on the ends of the torus if it is less than 360.

parameters.label: V End Caps
parameters.name: capv
parameters.description: If  V End Caps  is checked, it applies a face between the top and bottom of the torus - if the torus is open.

parameters.label: Texture Coordinates
parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: ⊞  - This adds uv coordinates to the geometry created by the Torus  SOP .

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: No uv coordinates added.

parameters.label: Row & Columns
parameters.name: rowcol
parameters.description: uv coordinates added based on Rows and Columns in the geometry.

parameters.label: Compute Normals
parameters.name: normals
parameters.description: Checking this option On will compute surface normals.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.description: edge shape.

parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.

Twist POP Conclusiones Los Operadores de Puntos (POPs) de TouchDesigner representan una evolución significativa en el manejo de datos 3D en tiempo real, ofreciendo un rendimiento superior gracias a su aceleración por GPU. Esta familia de operadores, aunque aún en fase "Experimental", es fundamental para desarrollar sistemas de partículas complejos, simulaciones a gran escala y efectos visuales generativos que super

bar variaciones o controlar el flujo de datos. • Experimental:Texture Map POP: Las fuentes proporcionadas no ofrecen una descripción detallada de la función específica de este operador. • Experimental:TOP to POP: Permite convertir datos de la familia TOPs (Texture Operators) a datos de POPs, específicamente para recuperar nubes de puntos. • Experimental:Topology POP: Las fuentes proporcionadas no ofrecen una descripción detallada de la función específica de este operador. • Experimental:Torus POP: Un operador generador que crea una geometría de toroide (forma de dona). • Experimental:Trail POP: Crea un historial de movimiento de un punto a lo largo del tiempo, generando una tira de línea para cada punto. Esto te permite visualizar la trayectoria de una partícula o punto a lo largo del tiempo. • Experimental:Transform POP: Un operador esencial para mover, rotar y escalar puntos o geometrías. Puede usar atributos de "peso" (Weight) para aplicar transformaciones parciales a los pun

* **Uso simple:** Para importar geometrías o nubes de puntos creadas en otros softwares o generadas a partir de datos externos. * **Point Generator POP (POP Generador de Puntos)** * **Función principal:** Crea un número específico de puntos, de forma aleatoria o con un patrón, sobre la **superficie** o dentro del **volumen** de una forma matemática básica (esfera, cubo, toro, etc.). * **Características clave:** * Permite elegir la **forma base** (Sphere, Box, Torus, Tube, Rectangle, Circle, Line). * Puedes generar puntos en la **superficie** o dentro del **volumen** de la forma. * Ofrece un control de `Random` (aleatoriedad) y `Seed` (semilla para el patrón aleatorio). * Capaz de añadir **normales (`N`) y tangentes (`T`)** a los puntos, vértices o primitivas, con opciones de aleatorización. * **Uso simple:** Una manera fácil de crear nubes de puntos o distribuir elementos en formas geométricas básicas para simulacio
